args.query: US agricultural exports to Thailand by country

sql: SELECT SUM(value_usd)/1e9 AS total_b, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(hs2 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 24 THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END)/1e9 AS ch01_24_b, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(hs2 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 24 OR CAST(hs2 AS INTEGER) IN (31,41,43,51,52) THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END)/1e9 AS broad_b FROM econ.trade_exports WHERE geo_level='country' AND country_name ILIKE 'Thailand' AND "year"='2025'

SELECT "year", SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(hs2 AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 24 THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END)/1e9 AS ch01_24_b, SUM(value_usd)/1e9 AS total_b FROM econ.trade_exports WHERE geo_level='country' AND country_name ILIKE 'Thailand' GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

args.query: monthly U.S. goods imports by country Census

sql: SELECT "year", SUM(value_usd)/1e9 AS imp_b FROM econ.trade_imports WHERE geo_level='country' AND country_name ILIKE 'Thailand' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
